discrimination.hostile_null: parametric: all systems within a bath share one true barrier; each cell mean is Gaussian noise N(0, sigma_R^2 / n_endpoint). Statistic = pooled between-system SD.

does_not_close: No coating-efficacy, product-performance, batch-release, or corrosion-rank authority.
Within-instrument discrimination is necessary but NOT sufficient for a validated corrosion rank; cross-modality corroboration remains underpowered at n=6.
Reproducibility estimated only where duplicate panels exist (DI/HAR baths); BOR/PRO cells have a single panel.
Single-frequency (0.01 Hz) data only: no Kramers-Kronig validation or full-spectrum equivalent-circuit fit possible.
Phase-1 would require >= the power-budget system count (r-dependent) of independent coating systems, or frequency-resolved KK-validated spectra.

dominant_noise_component.implication: The dominant uncertainty is the between-PANEL reproducibility component (s_L=0.836 decades), which time-averaging over more measurement dates CANNOT reduce -- only additional independent replicate panels can. Within-panel temporal repeatability (s_r=0.594) is the smaller term. Hence the benchmark's discrimination ceiling is set by replicate-panel count, not sampling frequency.

headline: First within-EIS reproducibility & discrimination-power audit of USBR-21019 (6 systems x 4 baths, replicate + temporal structure previously unused): ISO-5725 endpoint reproducibility sigma_R=1.026 decades (late-window between-panel 0.836 + repeatability 0.594), pooled between-system barrier spread 0.982 decades (SNR 0.96, F=0.9). Against a parametric hostile null (all systems identical, noise only) the single-date EIS endpoint does NOT separate the six within-bath systems above its measurement-noise floor (p=0.2554); the 80%-power minimum detectable |Z| difference is 4.06 decades (1 panel) / 2.87 (2 panels). The dominant term is between-PANEL reproducibility, which time-averaging cannot reduce -- only more replicate panels can. The prior audits' '12-20 systems' target is recovered only under the strong aggregate effect (r~0.77 -> n=11); at the observed within-bath effect (r~0.30) n~90 systems are required. Verdict: EIS_WITHIN_INSTRUMENT_DISCRIMINATION_NOT_ESTABLISHED.

interpretation.meaning: Partitions the prior 'underpowered' verdict: the EIS instrument's endpoint barrier signal DOES separate the six benchmark systems above its own ISO-5725 measurement-noise floor (parametric hostile-null p below), so the single-instrument benchmark has real within-instrument discrimination validity; what remains underpowered at n=6 is the CROSS-modality (EIS<->rust-creep) rank, whose required n is now grounded in the measured effect size rather than asserted.

measurement_uncertainty_budget_iso5725.note: between_panel sigma is from matched-DATE duplicate-panel differences so the shared exposure-time trend cancels; within_panel repeatability includes real specimen drift so it is an UPPER BOUND on short-term repeatability.

non_circularity: reproducibility sigma is from matched-date duplicate-panel differences (trend cancels) and is independent of the between-system signal it is compared to; all statistics invariant to EIS cell-area normalisation.
novelty_vs_prior_audits: Prior audits (eis-rustcreep-crossmodality, multi-instrument-concordance) used one scalar endpoint per cell and correlated ACROSS instruments. This is the first audit to use the replicate + temporal dimensions and to quantify the WITHIN-EIS measurement-noise floor and discrimination power.

cross_modality_rank_required_systems.effect_source: prior aggregate pairwise Spearman eis_barrier vs rustcreep_resistance

power_budget.reconciliation: The prior audits' asserted '>= ~12-20 systems' is recovered ONLY under the strong aggregate effect (r~0.77 -> n~11). At the weaker environment-stratified effect actually observed (r~0.30) the required n is ~90 systems, so 12-20 systems power the cross-modality rank only if the true barrier<->damage coupling is strong.

purpose: Estimate the EIS endpoint measurement-uncertainty budget from the previously-unused replicate + temporal structure of USBR-21019, test whether the between-system barrier signal exceeds that measurement-noise floor against a parametric hostile null, and convert the measured variance into a benchmark discrimination-power budget (minimum detectable |Z| difference; systems required to power the cross-modality rank) -- grounding the prior audits' asserted >=12-20 systems.

theory_reference.precision_model: ISO 5725-2:2019 one-way nested random-effects (repeatability s_r, reproducibility s_R)

units: log10 |Z|_0.01Hz decades (ohm); rank/variance statistics invariant to cell-area normalisation
